Command       │ What it does                          │ Exit|
──────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────┼─────|
memtro run    │ Runs one prompt and prints the        │    0|
              │ answer, then exits                    │|
memtro chat   │ Opens the full-screen interface       │    0|
memtro doctor │ Checks the install | config           │    1|
